candidates.title: Alicja Kwade: Waiting Pavilions

candidates.title: Ancient Egypt Unveiled: Treasures from Egyptian Museums

candidates.title: Treasures of Global Jewellery from The Metropolitan Museum of Art: The Body Transformed
candidates.blurb: The Met's jewellery collection deployed to position Hong Kong as neutral arbiter of global decorative arts.

candidates.title: A History of China in Silk: The Chris Hall Collection at the Hong Kong Palace Museum
candidates.blurb: A British collector's silk archive repatriated via private donation, framing textile history through connoisseurship.

candidates.title: Heavenly Horses: Masterpieces from the Palace Museum

candidates.title: Fermata: Hong Kong in Venice

candidates.title: Live: Hong Kong Art Exhibition
candidates.blurb: A survey of local contemporary practice staged by the public museum, signalling institutional confidence or necessity.

candidates.title: Proudly from Canton: The Muwen Tang Collection of Cantonese and Export Art
candidates.blurb: Export porcelain and Canton painting as argument for Hong Kong's historical role in translating China to the West.

candidates.title: Tai Kwun Neon Connection
candidates.blurb: Neon preservation project by heritage institution doubles as ambient critique of loss and commodification.
